title: SLK R172 petrol rough running -- known-issue reference (online research, 2026-08-23)

provenance.method: web research on M271 EVO and M276 rough-running/misfire complaints, Mercedes technical instructions and workshop guides; every claim carries its source
provenance.grade: reference-only: these are OTHER cars' failure statistics, not this car's diagnosis. The live capture decides; this file only suggests what to look for.

sim271de20_m271_turbo.name: M271 EVO DE18 LA turbo CGI 4-cyl (SLK200/250, 271.8)

issues.name: Intercooler condensation misfire (Mercedes LI07.70-P-059951)
issues.symptoms: CEL with P030100-P030400 during or after long steady drives in high humidity (>70%); intermittent; reduced power under full throttle.
issues.signature_hint: Misfires appear on ONE cylinder after sustained load/humidity, no hardware fault found on plugs/coils. Model 172 is explicitly in the LI's validity.
issues.fix: Only if XENTRY guided tests direct it: updated charge-air cooler A0995003501. Mercedes' own guidance first says: verify setting conditions, erase, release without parts.
sources: https://static.oemdtc.com/NHTSA-PDFs/MC-10135781-9999.pdf (LI07.70-P-059951 v3, validity model 204 + 172 with M271 EVO 271.8)

issues.name: Camshaft adjuster solenoid O-rings leak oil into the plug wells (Y49/1, Y49/2)
issues.symptoms: Rough idle, misfires P0301-P0304, cam phasing codes P0011/P0014, oil smell, oil residue in spark plug wells fouling coil bases. Often misdiagnosed as coils.
issues.signature_hint: One-two adjacent cylinders climbing; camshaft position DIDs (4010/4012) drifting off target; visual oil in plug wells confirms without any scanner.
issues.fix: Replace both solenoid O-rings (+ solenoids if scored), oil-stop loom kit A2711502733 x2, clean/replace fouled coils and plugs.

issues.name: Single-row timing chain stretch / guide wear
issues.symptoms: Cold-start rattle clearing in 30-60s, rough idle, P0016/P0017/P0341. Act immediately on rattle.
issues.signature_hint: Camshaft actual-vs-target deviation (DIDs 4010/4012) large or slow to settle after start; misfires random rather than one hole.
issues.fix: Chain, tensioner, guides + inspect adjuster sprockets (their teeth wear with the chain).

issues.name: Intake-valve carbon buildup (direct injection)
issues.symptoms: Rough idle on cold start clearing after 2-3 min warm-up, hesitation 1500-2500 rpm, P0300 random, elevated trims.
issues.signature_hint: Misfire counters climb mostly while cold (coolant < 60 C) and stop when warm; mixture adaptations drifted positive (lean).
issues.fix: Walnut-blast intake valves (~60k miles interval on DI engines); the Kompressor never suffers this, the EVO does.

issues.name: PCV / crankcase breather membrane failure
issues.symptoms: Rough idle, misfires, whistling at the oil cap, white smoke, oil in plug wells without cam-leak source, lean trims P0171.
issues.signature_hint: Positive trim drift with misfires spread across cylinders; strong vacuum at the filler cap.
issues.fix: Replace PCV membrane/valve assembly (e.g. A2661530059 family per forum reports).

issues.name: Piezo injector faults / boost hose cracking (EVO-specific)
issues.symptoms: Injectors: rough idle, P0201-P0204, hard cold start, limp. Hoses: hissing under load, P0299 underboost, power loss above 3000 rpm.
issues.signature_hint: Per-cylinder injection times (4050-4053) diverging on one hole points at its injector; underboost shows as MAP lower than expected for rpm.
issues.fix: Piezo injectors MUST be coded to the ECU after replacement; replace the full charge-pipe set, not one section.

issues.name: Camshaft magnet O-rings leak oil into the plug wells (six solenoids)
issues.symptoms: Misfires P0301-P0306, oil smell warm, oil-contaminated plug wells and coil bases, oil residue tracking from rear cam connectors.
issues.signature_hint: The climbing cylinders correspond to oil-fouled wells (bank-side clustering near the rear cam connectors).
issues.fix: All six O-ring seals inspected/replaced, harness cleaned, fouled coils/plugs replaced.

issues.name: Timing chain tensioner check-valve bleed-down (early DE35, TSB)
issues.symptoms: Rattle on startup for a few seconds, sometimes P0016/P0017 or cam-adjuster codes P002177/P001885 if an adjuster pin has skipped.
issues.signature_hint: Camshaft position deviations (4010-4013) right after start that settle once oil pressure builds; pressed-on cam tone wheels can loosen -- check for hard start + rough running together.
issues.fix: Check valves in tensioner oil supply + revised tensioners (pre-serial 276.8xx.30.000790); adjuster replacement if a pin skipped.

issues.name: High-pressure fuel pump wear
issues.symptoms: Stuttering/hesitation, rough idle, misfires, power loss, fuel-pressure codes.
issues.signature_hint: Rail pressure (206F/2071) sagging below its normal band exactly while misfire counters climb -- this is the pump-vs-ignition separator.
issues.fix: HPFP replacement; three-lobe cam-driven pump on the right intake camshaft.

issues.name: Intake-valve carbon buildup + breather oil ingestion (DI V6)
issues.symptoms: Rough cold idle, P0300 random, LTFT both banks drifting +10% or more; severe cases oil-fouled plugs from breather ingestion.
issues.signature_hint: Misfires concentrated in the cold window; multiplicative adaptations (6105/6106) above ~1.05 or trims positive on BOTH banks.
issues.fix: Walnut blast all 12 intake valves (~60k miles); trace the breather path before blaming coils.

bands.note: Counters are cumulative-per-drive-cycle values; a handful of counts over a whole run is normal. The bands are working thresholds for THIS workflow, to be re-tuned after the first real capture.
